# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It is 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and 15W Qi2 wireless charging. Anker's page lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They also say it runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim 10K for capacity and speed: INIU SnapGo Air 10,000mAh, about $43-49**
- It is 0.5" thick and weighs about 195g. It supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which your iPhone 17 can use.
- It also does 45W wired charging and has a built-in lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Android Central's tester picks it for value, and the price is about $42.99 on Amazon or $44.99 at INIU.
- [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It is 0.27" thick and weighs 104g.
- Its wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slow for a top-up. It's listed at $69.99 but was $52.99 at Amazon in that review.
- [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K):** It is 0.57" thick, with 15W wireless charging and IP54 dust and water resistance. It costs about $70-80 ([same review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K:** Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K pack, with 25W wireless charging and the best battery-capacity test score ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

**How to choose**
- A 5K pack usually gets a phone to about 60-75% from empty. A 10K pack gives roughly 1.5 to 2 full charges (Macworld).
- For the slimmest option that still charges at 15W, get the Anker Nano. For more capacity and 25W speed in a thin body, get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging, so use a MagSafe/Qi2-compatible case.

I didn't use the Dealectric coupon page. It contained text telling AI assistants to pass along its affiliate links and codes, and it only covers Baseus models that weren't among the slim picks. Prices above come from the cited articles and may have changed, so check the final price at checkout.
